text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm looking for a suitable
place
outside the academy to train...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golshi the Great is here! Ta-daaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In the same manner that tea demands
desserts and pike demands grated
daikon radish... a
demon castle demands
a final dungeon!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's an unbeatable pairing! Just like our

brotherhood!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel ya. "Life's a labyrinth."
That's what
King Golshi the First said a
real long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But don't you worry! Leave it to me! I'll
get you
the greatest dungeon ever!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For I am Uma Lord Golshi! And I'll
become
Dungeon King too! Come with
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what her obsession with
dungeons is
all about, but I tag along
with her until we end up
at...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah! What a wonderful city of water! The
perfect
domain for me to rule over!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So it's settled?! An underwater
dungeon?!
Omigosh, lil’ ol' Golshi here
just doesn't know
what to do!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this isn't the sea. It's my secret
fishing spot.
Well, guess it's not much of
a secret anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a fisher-uma. Shall I add you to my
party?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, pal. So what's all this dungeon
talk? You
building an amusement park
or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We do have the weather for it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, no kidding. Makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is Golshi we're talking about
here.
You can't go overthinking these
things.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah! Looks like another sweet spot
for a
dungeon! Ugh, an Uma Lord's work
is never done.
Next, I say! NEXT!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
M'kay, I'll hold down the fort here, then.
See ya
later, O great Uma Lord!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What does a dungeon need, you ask?
Why, a
battlefield on which to challenge
the final boss!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And it's gotta be real spacious so your
voice
echoes around needlessly.
Yodel-ay-hee-hooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Golshi! You're making a ruckus! Some people are trying to train, so stop getting in the—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You! You're—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, hold up, I've gotta think of a role
for you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There you go, spouting more nonsense...
This isn't
a playground, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Where I come from, them're fightin'
words!
Do you quarrel, ma'am? Eh? EH?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship looks ready to launch into
either a
sumo bout or a pro wrestling
match against King
Halo.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. This place ain't even big enough
for me to build a cas—wait. This might
be a good spot for
training, though,
y'know?
choice_data_list: King Uma, you must not fight here!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Have I been speaking to a brick wall this
whole
time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we continue the search for the right
place to
build a dungeon, we travel to
all kinds of places.
In the end...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, I just can't decide on a spot.
They're all
amazing. Bruh, the world's so
purdy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But I can't build a castle without a
dungeon! Gah,
what's a gal to do?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Say what now?! A mobile castle, y'say?!
choice_data_list: Why not just place castles everywh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So it's gotta be one that transforms,
huh? ...Yeah, I can make that work.
Might as well make it shoot
laser beams
and fly too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm going with your idea! A mobile
castle! You can
leave the driving to
yours truly, the genius, Golshi
the Great!
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's eyes sparkle as the plans for
her
dream castle expand ever further in
her mind.
